name: Backgammon (Declarative)
description: Move 15 checkers home and bear them off. Roll two dice; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. A point with two opposing checkers is blocked; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice, and the higher die if only one can be used. Bear off only when all your checkers are home. This uses the ordinary platform Backgammon rules, including its finite-match safeguard: after 120 turns or 300 actions, the player with more checkers off wins; ties favor player one.

cases.name: Intermediate move
cases.description: Move 15 checkers home and bear them off. Roll two dice; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. A point with two opposing checkers is blocked; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice, and the higher die if only one can be used. Bear off only when all your checkers are home. This uses the ordinary platform Backgammon rules, including its finite-match safeguard: after 120 turns or 300 actions, the player with more checkers off wins; ties favor player one.

cases.name: Terminal move
cases.description: Move 15 checkers home and bear them off. Roll two dice; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. A point with two opposing checkers is blocked; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice, and the higher die if only one can be used. Bear off only when all your checkers are home. This uses the ordinary platform Backgammon rules, including its finite-match safeguard: after 120 turns or 300 actions, the player with more checkers off wins; ties favor player one.

cases.name: Hit a blot
cases.description: Move 15 checkers home and bear them off. Roll two dice; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. A point with two opposing checkers is blocked; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice, and the higher die if only one can be used. Bear off only when all your checkers are home. This uses the ordinary platform Backgammon rules, including its finite-match safeguard: after 120 turns or 300 actions, the player with more checkers off wins; ties favor player one.

cases.name: Re-enter from bar
cases.description: Move 15 checkers home and bear them off. Roll two dice; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. A point with two opposing checkers is blocked; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice, and the higher die if only one can be used. Bear off only when all your checkers are home. This uses the ordinary platform Backgammon rules, including its finite-match safeguard: after 120 turns or 300 actions, the player with more checkers off wins; ties favor player one.

cases.name: Bear off
cases.description: Move 15 checkers home and bear them off. Roll two dice; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. A point with two opposing checkers is blocked; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice, and the higher die if only one can be used. Bear off only when all your checkers are home. This uses the ordinary platform Backgammon rules, including its finite-match safeguard: after 120 turns or 300 actions, the player with more checkers off wins; ties favor player one.

es.short_description: Lleva tus 15 fichas a casa y retíralas. Lanza dos dados; los dobles dan cuatro movimientos. Primero reingresa las fichas de la barra. Dos fichas rivales bloquean; una sola se captura. Usa el máximo de dados y el mayor si solo puedes usar uno. Retira solo con todas tus fichas en casa. Se usan las reglas normales de la plataforma: tras 120 turnos o 300 acciones gana quien haya retirado más; el empate favorece al primer jugador.

fr.short_description: Ramenez vos 15 pions et sortez-les. Lancez deux dés ; un double donne quatre déplacements. Rentrez les pions de la barre en premier. Deux pions adverses bloquent ; un pion seul est frappé. Utilisez le maximum de dés, et le plus fort si un seul est jouable. Sortez quand tous vos pions sont dans votre jan intérieur. Règles ordinaires de la plateforme : après 120 tours ou 300 actions, le plus de pions sortis gagne ; égalité au premier joueur.

de.short_description: Bringe 15 Steine ins Heimfeld und würfle sie heraus. Zwei Würfel; ein Pasch gibt vier Züge. Steine von der Bar zuerst einsetzen. Zwei gegnerische Steine sperren, ein einzelner wird geschlagen. Nutze möglichst viele Würfel, bei nur einem möglichen den höheren. Auswürfeln erst mit allen Steinen im Heimfeld. Es gelten die normalen Plattformregeln: Nach 120 Runden oder 300 Aktionen gewinnt die höhere Zahl ausgewürfelter Steine, bei Gleichstand Spieler eins.
